text:
mira: Heads-up: we want the release announcement live tomorrow 10:00am PT. Marketing needs: final one-liner changelog for the blog intro, canonical docs link, a tiny bench callout for the hero, webinar CTA, and confirmation of inbound form tags. Also: should we call out the fallback (smaller model) in the blog or keep that internal?

 lee: Canary plan from infra: ramp 5% @T+10m, 30% @T+45m, 100% @T+3h if healthy. Thresholds: p95 < 360ms, error_rate < 0.4%. Auto-rollback on sustained error_rate > 0.5% for 10m. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog/pull/678

 aditi: Docs staging is up at https://docs.redwood.ai/staging/releases/1.2.6. Examples updated to show batching_mode: "adaptive". Need eng sign-off on the example response.

 lee: Signed off on examples. Note for blog copy: mention KV warm-start improvement and adaptive batching. Keep fallback model note internal (ops/SDR can see it) — don't publish unless legal asks.

 deploy-bot: Canary scheduled by @lee at 2024-06-03T17:00:00Z. Hooks: latency_p95, error_rate, token_cost. Auto-rollback configured.

 jon: Bench blurb candidate: "Adaptive batching lowered p95 by ~17% on our chat sample and reduced token cost by ~8%." Can trim for hero. I'll export the before/after graph to internal assets.

 tayla: Webinar slot confirmed Thu 11am ET. Landing page to include register CTA and webinar link. I'll add webinar CTA to the blog draft. Who's presenting? Product + 10min infra demo from Lee.

 mira: Good. Inbound routing: tag forms with campaign=release_jun_1_2_6 and source=blog. HubSpot workflow will create SFDC lead and assign to SDR pool C. Ops-bot, can you confirm webhook status?

 ops-bot: Webhook health OK. Last test at 2024-06-02T22:15:00Z. Mappings: email, company, campaign, utm_source confirmed.

 lee: Small deployment note for changelog string: "Enabled adaptive batching, improved KV cache warm-start for faster initial responses, and rolled out a staged canary with auto-rollback on elevated error rates."

 jon: Hero short: "p95 ↓ ~17%, token cost ↓ ~8%." Graph asset uploaded: https://internal.redwood/assets/releases/1-2-6/p95-cost.png

 mira: Perfect. Final checklist: lee paste that changelog line here (done), aditi publish canonical docs permalinks, tayla confirm webinar CTA copy, ops-bot confirm routing (done). If no blockers, I'll schedule publish at 10:00am PT tomorrow. :rocket:

 aditi: Canonical docs link: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/1.2.6 — canonical and live after final MD merge.

 tayla: CTA copy: "Join our launch webinar — live demo + Q&A (Thu 11am ET). Register here." Putting it in the blog draft now.

 mira: Locking publish at 10:00am PT unless a blocker appears. Thanks all :tada:
